risks.title: Supply constraints on Blackwell Ultra
risks.quote: Shipments of Data Center Hopper products to China during the quarter were less than 1% of Data Center revenue.
risks.explanation: The quote indicates limited supply to China, which could restrict revenue growth from that market.

risks.title: Rising compute infrastructure and compensation costs
risks.quote: GAAP operating expenses for the second quarter were up 55% from a year ago and up 10% sequentially, and non-GAAP operating expenses were up 54% from a year ago and up 11% sequentially. These increases were driven by higher compute infrastructure and compensation and benefits costs.
risks.explanation: The quote describes cost pressures that could erode margins, though no specific financial impact is quantified.

risks.title: Extended payment terms increasing accounts receivable
risks.quote: Accounts receivable was $63.1 billion with 60 days sales outstanding (DSO), up from 45 days sequentially, due to extended payment terms on large, multi-quarter agreements with certain investment-grade customers.
risks.explanation: The quote highlights cash flow risk from longer receivable cycles, which may strain liquidity.
